title: Better Entity Control
description: Take full control over mob and projectile attributes — modify health, damage, speed, armor, knockback, scale for mobs, and damage, speed, gravity, knockback for projectiles, with commands in Russian and English.
body:
Better Entity Control gives you full control over entity attributes in Minecraft.

MOBS:
Configure health, damage, speed, armor, knockback, and scale for any mob. All changes apply immediately to existing and newly spawned entities.

PROJECTILES:
Modify damage, speed, gravity, and knockback for projectiles like arrows, fireballs, and throwable items. Projectiles shot by configured mobs inherit their settings automatically.

COMMANDS:
/entitycontrol entities mobs
/entitycontrol entities projectiles
/entitycontrol entities reset
/entitycontrol entities list

CONFIG:
All settings are saved in JSON format in config/better_entity_control/. Edit them manually or use in-game commands.

Discord:
Go through my profile to our Discord server, where you can follow updates, report bugs, and suggest ideas https://discord.gg/7vyXv8uUnE

🐔Eternal Chicken (Minecraft: Story Mode) - Better Entity Control 1.0.1

Author of the idea - Flov, A member of our discord community - https://discord.gg/7vyXv8uUnE

- Activation: Right-click a chicken with a configurable transformation item (default: Diamond) — it starts glowing and drops items from the config with a configurable interval.

Commands:

 - /entitycontrol entities chicken drop <min> <max> — drop interval (in ticks)

 - /управление сущности курица дроп <мин> <макс>

 - /entitycontrol entities chicken transformation <item> — activation item

 - /управление сущности курица трансформация <предмет>

 - /entitycontrol entities chicken item add <item> <weight> — add to drop table

 - /управление сущности курица предмет добавить <предмет> <вес>

 - /entitycontrol entities chicken item remove <item> — remove from drop table

 - /управление сущности курица предмет удалить <предмет>
